entity.title: Agent behavior
entity.description: The current behavior of an agent in plain language (role and state texts in the cm) and the history of its changes with author, date and a one-line summary; changed or undone through the cm.

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: The agent whose behavior this is, as the cm identifies it.

currentBehavior.title: Current behavior
currentBehavior.description: The agent's current behavior in plain language, built by the cm from its role and state texts.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A one-line summary of the current behavior, shown as the title of the behavior scenario.

changeRequest.title: What do you want to change
changeRequest.description: The plain-language request the admin writes in the box; the cm turns it into a new behavior.

changes.title: History of changes
changes.description: Past changes to the agent's behavior, newest first, as the cm keeps them.

changeRef.title: Change
changeRef.description: The cm's reference to this change, used to undo it; never shown on screen.

changedBy.title: Who
changedBy.description: The person who made the change.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: A one-line summary of what changed.

undone.title: Undone
undone.description: Whether this change was later undone through the cm.
